label.en: A storm is on the horizon.

label.en: After a random delay (about fifty years): the echoes near the rim

texts.zh: 我们探测到了一个相对我们星系具有接近矢量的神秘亚空间信号群。看来马上有访客要来了……
texts.en: A mysterious cluster of subspace contacts has been detected on an approach vector with our galaxy. It would appear that we are about to receive visitors...

texts.zh:
我们在星系际空间探测到的奇怪亚空间回声现已接近我们的星系外缘。在回声主体前进的方向上似乎出现了一系列微小的联络信号，并指向许多的边缘恒星系。

我们已经把这些星系坐标输入状态日志并将持续监控情况发展。
texts.en:
The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.

We have entered the positions of these systems into the Situation Log and will continue to monitor the situation.

label.zh: 随机延时后（约十年）：亚空间信号
label.en: After a random delay (about ten years): the subspace signal

texts.zh: 我们接收到了席卷整个星系的强烈亚空间信号！信号源似乎正是来自此前位于星系际空间的联络。
texts.en: We are picking up a strong subspace signal washing over the galaxy! Its point of origin appears to be the contacts approaching from intergalactic space.

label.zh: 随机延时后（约两年半）：先锋抵达银河边缘
label.en: After a random delay (about two and a half years): the vanguard reaches the rim

notes.zh: 正文按能否理解索林原虫而不同：一般帝国只收到无法翻译的信号；灵能物种或蜂巢思维物种可读出内容。
notes.en: The text depends on whether the empire can understand the Prethoryn: most empires receive an untranslatable signal; psionic or hive-minded species can read it.

texts.zh:
我们收到的资料显示一些位于星系边缘的恒星系正在被某种入侵势力蹂蹑。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。目前为止，接踵而至的报告都令人十分困惑，入侵者所使用的舰船似乎是由有机质构成，并且入侵者暂未对我们做出任何回应。

我们整个星系或将面对史无前例的入侵。
texts.en:
We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard - the main body of contacts has yet to arrive. Reports have so far been confused, but the "ships" used by the invaders appear organic in nature and do not respond to hails.

Our entire galaxy may be facing an invasion of unprecedented scope.

texts.zh:
来自边缘外围恒星系的报告令人不寒而栗，那里有一支入侵实力正在横扫群星。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。但这些实体已经让人感觉不对劲了。它们的形体仿佛是一种是对生命的畸形嘲弄，带着一种不可理喻的渴望跳动着。它们不交流，不寻求理解——只吞噬一切。

我们已熟悉活体星舰的低语，也就是舰船和主体之间的纽带。而这些东西呢？他们是真正意义上的异类。星系面临的不仅仅是侵略者。它正面临着本不应该存在的一种饥渴。
texts.en:
Reports from our outlying systems along the galactic rim are dire, an invasion force is sweeping across the stars. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard. The true mass of the incursion has yet to arrive. But already, something about these entities feels wrong. Their forms are grotesque mockeries of life, pulsing with a hunger we do not recognize. They do not communicate, do not seek understanding - only consumption.

We have long known the whisper of living starships, the bond between vessel and master. But these things? They are alien in the truest sense. The galaxy is not facing mere invaders. It is facing a hunger that should not exist.

label.zh: 将消息传达给所有舰队指挥官。
必须近距离研究这些生物。
label.en: These creatures must be studied closer.

label.zh: 真的无法与他们进行理论吗？
label.en: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?
This will cut into our profit margins...

label.zh: 可恶的外星生物，一定要把它们统统干掉。
label.en: These wretched xenos will be purged.

label.zh: 真是令人着迷……系外的生命体。
label.en: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.

label.zh: 他们的思维是完全统一的。真神奇。
label.en: They act as a single mind. Remarkable.

label.zh: 这对任何有感知的生物来说都是个威胁。
label.en: This is a threat to all sapient life.

texts.zh: 我们的星系被一群贪婪的星际生物入侵了，他们意图吞食所有遇到的生命体。必须在这些索林原虫入侵者的数量超过我们之前消灭他们。
texts.en: Our galaxy has been invaded by a ravenous swarm of spacefaring creatures that seem intent on consuming all life in their path. The rampage of these Prethoryn invaders must be stopped before their numbers overwhelm us.

texts.zh:
我们的重力陷阱无法准确地追踪收容虫群天灾。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。

尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。

我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。
texts.en:
Our Gravity Snares are unable to properly track and contain the Prethoryn Scourge. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh: JARAK？
texts.en: JARAK?

texts.zh: TUROSKMINA.DOROF!
texts.en: TUROSK MINA. DOROF!

texts.zh: 穆噶尼？蛤 蛤 蛤！
texts.en: MUGANI? HAK HAK HAK!

texts.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

它居然能听得懂？
texts.en:
<Mind Link Established>

IT CAN UNDERSTAND?

texts.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

猎人是绝不留情的。
texts.en:
<Mind Link Established>

THE HUNTERS WILL NOT RELENT.

texts.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

我们可以感受到你的存在……
texts.en:
<Mind Link Established>

WE CAN SENSE YOU...

responses.zh: JASKA？
responses.en: JASKA!

label.zh: 我们一定还有和平共处的办法！
label.en: There must be some way for us to co-exist in peace!

responses.zh: NIKALLADUSAM!NIBLIRTOVASSU!HAKHAKHAK!
responses.en: NIKALLA DUSAM! NIBLIR TO VASSU! HAK HAK HAK!

label.en: Run back to whichever galaxy you crawled out of.

responses.zh: VEKIKT'UHANVELOSH.PIROK。
responses.en: VEKIK T'UHAN VELOSH. PIROK.

label.zh: 你是我们见过的最恶心的生物。
label.en: You are the most disgusting life form we have encountered.

responses.zh: LUSAAAAAGH!VIDMUSABAGH!
responses.en: LUSAAAAAGH! VID MUSABAGH!

label.zh: 显然，这次我们对付的种群可不一般。
label.en: This is clearly an important species we're dealing with.

responses.zh: JUSUGAMAK V'TA！RAGAH TUR，HAK HAK！
responses.en: JUSUGAMAK V'TA! RAGAH TUR, HAK HAK!

label.zh: 滚回自己老巢去吧，你们这些恶魔！
label.en: Return to the hell which spawned you, demon!

responses.zh: HAKHAK!NIMAVU!!!
responses.en: HAK HAK! NIMA VU!!!

label.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
label.en: Can there be peace between us?

responses.zh:
不接受和平。我们必须进食。

只有吞噬了这个星系，才能继续我们那漫长的旅途。
responses.en:
NO PEACE. WE MUST FEED.

ONLY WHEN WE HAVE FINISHED CONSUMING THIS GALAXY SHALL WE DEPART TO CONTINUE OUR LONG JOURNEY.

label.zh: 你口中的“猎人”到底是什么人？
label.en: Who are these "Hunters" you speak of?

responses.zh:
是死神。他们已经将我方消灭殆尽，连我们这群最后的幸存者，也被他们追杀了无数个纪元。

他们终有一天会找到这里。我们必须尽快进食，以便在他们到来之前再次遁入宇宙的黑暗之中继续潜逃。
responses.en:
DEATH. THEY HAVE MADE US THE LAST OF OUR KIND, AND THEY HAVE HUNTED US, THE SURVIVORS, FOR EONS.

THEY WILL COME HERE ONE DAY. WE MUST FEED UNTIL THEN, SO THAT WE CAN FLEE BACK INTO THE DARKNESS BETWEEN GALAXIES WHEN THEY ARRIVE.

label.zh: 那“普雷索林”是什么意思呢？

responses.zh: 是幸存者的意思。我们这些幸存者是整个种群最后的希望了。
responses.en: SURVIVORS. WE ARE THE LAST.

label.zh: 我们会把你们从星系中清除掉。
label.en: We will scour this galaxy of your kind.

responses.zh:
这话我们以前可没少听。哈哈哈！

猎人会消灭世间万物。在这个残酷的现实面前，你们那区区威胁又算得了什么？
responses.en:
WE HAVE HEARD THIS BEFORE. HA! HA! HA!

THE HUNTERS WILL SCOUR ALL OF CREATION. WHAT IS YOUR EMPTY THREAT IN THE FACE OF SUCH TRUTHS?

responses.zh: 它消逝了。
responses.en: IT FADES.

notes.en: A repeatable diplomacy screen, not the next story step. Understanding the swarm depends on can_talk_to_prethoryn: a psionic or hive-minded species, or the Behemoth Fury menace perk Mind Meld.

texts.zh:
我们已经无法从星系的背景辐射中分辨出亚空间回声的主体，这只意味着一件事情……他们已经到来。

如果以他们先锋的规模作为参考，那么这些入侵者的军队数量将是无比巨大的。
texts.en:
We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.

If the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must be massive.

title.zh: 与星海监管人并肩而战……
title.en: Stand by for the Galactic Custodian...

texts.zh:
星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。

星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。

在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击[crisis_country.GetName]的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。
texts.en:
Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.

This is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that may be the case.

When you elected us as your Galactic Custodians, we swore an oath to defend our galaxy and we will do everything in our power to uphold that promise... but this is not a battle we can win alone. We call on all members to put aside their differences and join us as we strike back at the [crisis_country.GetName]! Together we will show them the full might of our galaxy as it stands united against a common foe!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

texts.zh:
星海已四面楚歌！[crisis_country.GetName]盯上了我们的军队，但我们毫无能长时间抵抗的希望！

作为星海的监管人，保护全体共同体成员不受外界的威胁是您应尽的职责，请尽您所能地提供援助吧！
texts.en:
The galaxy is under attack! Our forces have engaged the [crisis_country.GetName], but we have little hope of holding them off for long!

As the Galactic Custodians, it is your duty to defend all Community members from external threats! Please, send all the help you can!

title.en: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...

texts.zh:
帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被[crisis_country.GetName]威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。

但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。

在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！
texts.en:
Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.

But do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.

Rally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!

note.zh: 游戏会按政体显示统治者的头衔。
note.en: The game shows the ruler's title for your government.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

texts.zh:
帝皇陛下，星海正处于前所未有的险境之中。我们的军队正遭受[crisis_country.GetName]的严重威胁。一旦我方被击败，他们一定会吞并帝国的剩余部分！

作为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，保护帝国全体国民是你应尽的职责。我们恳请您即刻出兵！
texts.en:
Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!

As the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!

note.zh: 游戏会按政体显示统治者的头衔。
note.en: The game shows the ruler's title for your government.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

texts.zh:
一个同索林原虫进行战斗的军事组织最近在星系崭露头角。这个组织的成员似乎主要由无家可归、受尽蹂躏的人组成——难民、退役军人、以及其他在虫灾冲击中失去一切的人。

尽管如此，他们拼凑出来的舰队仍旧设法在几场同索林原虫猎杀群的战斗中取胜。有些未证实的报告称他们的舰队中有一些设计奇特的战舰……
texts.en:
Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of the Scourge.

Despite this, their ramshackle fleets have somehow managed to win several engagements against Prethoryn hunter-killer swarms. There are unconfirmed reports that their fleets include starships of unusual design...

label.zh: 这些人到底是什么来历？
此后可随时联络哨兵组织（可重复的通讯）
label.en: From now on you may contact the Sentinels (repeatable communication)

label.zh: 击毁7支以上虫群舰队且哨兵舰船多于30艘：赠舰提议（平均100个月）
label.en: After destroying 7+ swarm fleets, while the Sentinels have 30+ ships: a fleet offer (MTTH 100 months)

label.zh: 虫群占据银河过半，一年后哨兵公开解剖资料
label.en: When the swarm holds over half the galaxy, the Sentinels share anatomy files a year later

label.zh: 若虫群摧毁哨兵阿尔法空间站
label.en: If the swarm destroys Sentinel Alpha

texts.zh:
我们是哨兵。我们的教团已宣誓无论付出任何代价也要阻止嗜血的索林原虫。其他帝国放弃抵抗之时，我们仍旧坚持斗争。他们向虫灾缴械投降时，我们会给予他们反击的手段。

我是克加斯大团长，教团的首席。不要以貌取人——哨兵教团从星系中所有种族，包括你的种族——招兵买马。我们只希望你们的政府能够坚持对抗索林原虫的入侵，并在可能时支持我们。
texts.en:
We are the Sentinels. Our order has sworn to halt the murderous rampage of the Prethoryn no matter the cost. Where other empires crumble, we stand firm. Where they abandon their own to the Scourge, we give them the means to fight back.

I am Grand Master Korgas, the first of our order. Do not be deceived by my appearance - Sentinels are recruited from all species in the galaxy, including yours. We ask only that your government keep up the fight against the Prethoryn and support our Sentinels where possible.

label.zh: 你们是如何成功抵御虫族的？
label.en: How are you able to fight back?

responses.zh:
许多哨兵都拥有军旅背景。我们来自于一系列在与索林原虫虫群作战中战败的不同舰队的幸存者。作为哨兵，我们已从过去的错误中汲取教训并且努力工作以免类似的情况再次发生。

同样地，相信我已经提到过，我们招募的人员来自星系的所有种族。其中也包括了那些古老的种族，例如[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们得到了 [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]的几个有影响力的派系支持，他们不希望看到自己的星系被虫群吞噬。他们为我们的事业捐赠了船只和资源。
responses.en:
Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.

Also, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. This includes the elder races, such as the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have the support of several influential factions within the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName] who have no wish to see their galaxy devoured. They have donated both ships and resources to our cause.

label.zh: 你们是如何成功抵御虫族的？
label.en: How are you able to fight back?

responses.zh:
很多哨兵都有军旅背景。我们都曾是与索林原虫战斗的各个舰队的幸存者。虽然曾经战败，但我们汲取了过去的经验与教训，并争取不再重蹈覆辙。

就像之前所说过的，哨兵队的成员来自星系的各个物种。我们的希望寄托在一小队已不在此星系出现的失落帝国幸存者身上——他们向我们援助秘密科技和封存的舰队。
responses.en:
Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.

Also, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. We count among our numbers a handful of scattered survivors from an ancient fallen empire that no longer maintains a presence in this galaxy. They have given us access to secret technology caches and mothballed warfleets.

responses.zh:
我们已经在[sentinel_system.GetName]附近建立了总部。这里曾经是一个未被标明的黑洞。是[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]将这个地点告诉我们的。他们还协助建设了哨兵阿尔法——我们首座空间设施，也是我们舰队的母港。

这可以说是一项标志性的成就，尤其是在我们的时间如此紧迫的条件下。
responses.en:
We have established our headquarters near [sentinel_system.GetName]. The coordinates of this previously uncharted black hole were given to us by the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]. They also aided in the construction of Sentinel Alpha, our primary space installation and the home port of our fleets.

It is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. Especially given the limited time we had.

responses.zh:
我们已经在[sentinel_system.GetName]附近建立了总部。这里曾经是一个未被标明的黑洞。我们通过一个已经消失的失落帝国的数据库恢复了该黑洞的位置。在此数据库中，我们还获得了一些技术图纸，并在哨兵阿尔法的建设中派上了用场。这是我们首座空间设施，也是我们舰队的母港。

这可以说是一项标志性的成就，尤其是在我们的时间如此紧迫的条件下。
responses.en:
We have established our headquarters near [sentinel_system.GetName]. The coordinates of this uncharted black hole were recovered by our agents from the ancient databanks of a fallen empire now lost to history. From this databank we also obtained technical schematics that aided in the construction of Sentinel Alpha, our primary space installation and the home port of our fleets.

It is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. Especially given the limited time we had.

responses.zh:
坚持战斗，我亲爱的朋友们。我们整个星系的命运前途未卜。

哨兵一号，完毕。
responses.en:
Keep up the fight, dear friends. The fate of our entire galaxy hangs in the balance.

Sentinel One out.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个失落帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this fallen empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些古老种族的复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of these ancient peoples appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们星系的未来只有两条路可以走：要么虫群天灾消灭这个星系里所有的有机生命，然后继续他们毁灭的进程，要么我们将那些卑鄙的生物消灭得一干二净。
texts.en: Our galaxy is faced with two possible futures: either the Prethoryn Scourge consumes all organic life and moves on, or they are destroyed to the last of their despicable kind.

texts.zh: 我们必须加倍努力对抗虫灾。这场战争关乎整个星系的命运。
texts.en: We must redouble our efforts against the Scourge. This is a struggle that involves the entire galaxy.

texts.zh: 现在国与国之间的争斗已经没有任何意义了。用飞船来对付自己人而不是虫族，简直就是莫大的浪费。
texts.en: Conflicts between nations are pointless now. Any warships that are lost in battle to anyone or anything other than the Scourge must be considered an incredible waste.

texts.zh: 不要失去希望。我们的星系仍然有机会胜利。
texts.en: Do not lose hope. The battle for our galaxy can still be won.

label.zh: 关于虫族，你们知道多少？
label.en: What can you tell us about the Prethoryn?

responses.zh:
诶，我们所知道的也不多，但是可以肯定的是他们源于星系之外。他们很有可能在来到我们的星系前摧毁了数十甚至上百的星系…或也许我们是第一个受害者。

在他们完成对整个星球上所有非索林原虫生命的屠戮后，他们将星球转化成了只能用扭曲的噩梦来形容的地狱。其他一切生命形式在这些孵化星球上都无法存活，想要净化星球只有一个办法，那就是用强烈的轨道轰炸烧光整个生物圈。
responses.en:
Alas, we don't know as much as we would like, but they are clearly extragalactic in origin. It is possible that they have devoured dozens or even hundreds of other galaxies before they reached ours... or we could be the first victims beyond their own home galaxy.

After they have finished consuming all non-Prethoryn life on a planet, they terraform it into what can only be described as a twisted nightmare. These Infested Worlds are hostile to all other forms of life, and the only way to cleanse the infestation is to burn away the entire biosphere with intense orbital bombardment.

responses.zh: 战争仍会继续。护卫舰一号，完毕。
responses.en: The struggle continues. Sentinel One signing off.

texts.zh:
哨兵对于你们抵抗虫群天灾的英勇事迹十分赞赏。既然[Root.GetName]的舰队指挥官已经掌握了克敌制胜的诀窍，我们希望将自己的舰队之一永久交予你方。我方目前人力不足，无法将舰队的威力发挥到最大，但对你们来说这应该不成问题。

不过你们一定要郑重承诺，只把这些舰船用来对抗虫灾！
texts.en:
The Sentinels have taken note of your valiant struggle against the Prethoryn Scourge. Since the fleet commanders of the [Root.GetName] clearly know how to win battles, we would like to permanently transfer one of our battle fleets over to your control. We currently lack the manpower to effectively crew these vessels, but that shouldn't be a problem for you.

You must solemnly promise to only use these warships against the Scourge, however!

label.zh: 当然……我们只会用来对抗虫灾。
label.en: Of course... only against the Scourge.

responses.zh: 很好。我们相信，你们英勇的舰长将会与这些伟大飞船一起永载史册。我们会把舰队送到[Root.Capital.GetName]附近。
responses.en: Excellent. We are certain that your brave captains will add to the storied histories of these magnificent warships. You will find the fleet near [Root.Capital.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 一艘哨兵舰船出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]附近，并交由你控制。
tooltips.en: A Sentinel fleet appears near [Root.Capital.GetName] and is transferred over to your control.

label.zh: 我们不需要你们的飞船。
label.en: We have no need of your warships.

responses.zh: 那也没有关系。我们只希望你们能够继续战斗。每消灭一只虫族，我们离胜利也就更进一步。
responses.en: We understand. Then we ask only that you keep up the fight, friends. Every wretched Prethoryn that you blow out of the stars is a victory for the entire galaxy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的首都的名称。
note.en: In the game, your capital's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
这里是哨兵一号。星系已经到了危难时刻，但我还是要告诉你们一些好消息。

通过在漫长的战斗中吸取到的经验，以及艰苦的研究，我们的特工终于编制出来了极为详尽的虫群天灾生物的解剖资料。例如，你们是否知道索林原虫幼虫在主胆囊和副胆囊同时被刺穿的情况下就会剧烈燃烧？

我们要将这些文件公之于众。你们可以瞄准我们发现的这些弱点进行攻击，这样你们的飞船就能够更加高效地进行战斗。
texts.en:
This is Sentinel One. These are truly desperate times for the galaxy, but I am here to bring you some good news.

Through extensive combat experience and painstaking research, Sentinel agents have compiled extremely detailed anatomy files on the creatures of the Prethoryn Scourge. For example, did you know that Prethoryn Swarmlings have been known to violently combust if both their primary and secondary gallbladders are punctured at the same time?

We are making these files available to everyone in the galaxy. By targeting the weaknesses we have found, you should find that your fleets are much more effective in battle against the Scourge.

label.zh: 将这些资料上传至瞄准计算机。
label.en: Upload this data to our targeting computers.

texts.zh:
据报告，[sentinel_system.GetName]附近出现激烈的战斗。哨兵组织的母星系处于崩溃的边缘。

我们收到了一段从哨兵阿尔法——哨兵组织用作总部的军用空间站，传来的长程通讯片段。该恒星系因大量武器发射和能量残余造成了严重的信号干扰。
texts.en:
Intense fighting has been reported in the immediate vicinity of [sentinel_system.GetName]. The home system of the Sentinels is on the verge of being overrun.

We have picked up a partial long-range transmission from Sentinel Alpha, the battlestation that serves as the headquarters of the Sentinel Order. Jamming and residual energy pockets from the massive amount of weapon discharges now occurring within the system are causing heavy signal interference.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
这里……这里是哨兵阿尔法。我们遭遇###信号损坏###……致命损伤。舰体已经凹陷，并且###信号损坏###……团长已确认牺牲。敌人数量实在太多！

我们……已经完蛋了。不要放弃。为了我们的未来，你们绝对不能投降。不要让我们的努力白费！我们……我们……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——<信号丢失>
texts.en:
This... this is Sentinel Alpha. We have ###SIGNAL CORRUPTION### ...sustained critical damage. The hull is buckling, and ###SIGNAL CORRUPTION### ...Grand Master confirmed dead. There are simply too many of them!

It's... it's over for us. Keep up the fight. For the sake of future generations, you must not yield. Do not let our sacrifice be in vain! We have... we... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH---- <SIGNAL LOST>

texts.zh:
我们的一架深空侦察探机闯入了一处位于[queen_system.GetName]的战场余骸，这场战斗的双方是索林虫族和某未知势力。一只索林原虫虫后似乎在战斗之后受了重伤，被抛弃在此，任其自生自灭。

用于侦察的探机汇报称，虫后仍一息尚存。现在是难得一遇的活捉虫后的好机会。
texts.en:
A deep space spy drone has stumbled upon the site of what appears to have been a recent space battle between the Prethoryn and a second, as yet unidentified, party in the [queen_system.GetName] system. A Prethoryn Queen was badly injured in the fighting, and seems to have been left for dead.

The spy drone has reported that the creature is still alive, however. This could be a priceless opportunity to capture the Queen alive.

label.en: Perhaps we should send an expedition.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that star system appears here.

texts.zh: [queen_system.GetName]星系最近发生了一场太空战，一只索林原虫虫后重伤濒死，但其仍有生命体征。捕获它将是情报界的一场重大胜利。
texts.en: After a recent space battle in the [queen_system.GetName] system, a Prethoryn Queen was badly injured and left for dead by the rest of the Scourge. The creature is still alive, however. Capturing it would be a major intelligence coup.

label.zh: 另一帝国先完成捕获，你的项目中止
label.en: Another empire completes the capture first; your project is aborted

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that star system appears here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]治愈了索林原虫虫后的几处重伤。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]切除了虫后用来与同族联系的器官，并替换为小型正电子植入体，完全控制了虫后。

现在虫后任由我们差遣，肚子里也正在孕育索林原虫的幼体。这些幼体只会听命于这只虫后，也就是说，只会听命于我们。只要虫后活着，我们就能培育出大量被驯化的索林原虫大军！
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has managed to heal the worst of the Prethoryn Queen's injuries. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] removed the organ responsible for the creature's subspace connection with the rest of the Scourge, and replaced it with a small positronic implant that gives us control over it.

We can now order the Queen around, and it has already started breeding new Prethoryn creatures that are loyal to it, and thus, by extension, us. As long as we can keep the Queen alive, we should be able to grow a fleet of domesticated Prethoryn creatures!

label.zh: 想必这会是有用的战力！
label.en: They should prove an extremely useful asset!

label.zh: 灵能物种帝国：被俘虫后躁动（平均100年）
label.en: Psionic species: the captured Queen grows restless (MTTH 100 years)

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the science officer's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the ship's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们抓到的索林原虫虫后在前几个月里变得越来越暴躁不安。起先我们以为它只不过是因为与其他同类失去了联络，但后来我们的[get.telepaths.plural]收到了它的通讯，说着什么“虚空之洞”云云。

我们在研究索林原虫的跨星系旅行方法、并在天文数据库中发现了一个差异时才明白它说的到底是什么意思。绘制索林原虫可能走过的路径的过程中，我们发现一个距离我们大约3000万光年的小螺旋星系不见了。

那个星系我们曾在太空时代早期发现并研究过，但现在已经不再发出任何可被我们仪器探测到的光。这一意料之外的奇特发现让我们的科学家们争先恐后地想解释到底是什么东西导致了整个星系从宇宙中消失。

目前有两种解释：要么是星系中的恒星突然全部熄灭，要么是有某种东西，某种大得足以遮蔽整个星系的东西，挡住了它照射过来的光。这两种理论似乎都难以置信，许多人谴责它们荒唐可笑，并且更倾向于认为这个消失的星系本就不存在，只是是由于对原始望远镜的错误使用而产生的。尽管如此，整个事件透着一种明显的恐惧和噩兆……
texts.en:
Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.

What it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.

The galaxy, discovered and studied during the early space era of our species, is simply no longer emanating any form of light observable by our instruments. This bizarre and unexpected discovery sent our scientists into a scramble to try and explain what could cause an entire galaxy to simply vanish from the sky.

Two explanations emerged: Either the stars of the galaxy simply went out, all at once, or there is something, something so vast as to eclipse an entire galaxy, blocking its light from reaching us. Both theories seem equally implausible, and many have simply decried them as ludicrous, preferring to think that the missing galaxy never existed at all, invented by some erroneous use of a primitive telescope. Nonetheless, a palpable sense of dread and foreboding surrounds the whole incident...

texts.zh:
我们抓到的索林原虫虫后在前几个月里变得越来越暴躁不安。起先我们以为它只不过是因为与其他同类失去了联络，但后来我们的[get.telepaths.plural]收到了它的通讯，说着什么“虚空之洞”云云。

我们在研究索林原虫的跨星系旅行方法、并在天文数据库中发现了一个差异时才明白它说的到底是什么意思。绘制索林原虫可能走过的路径的过程中，我们发现一个距离我们大约3000万光年的小螺旋星系不见了。

从我们的太空时代早期开始，这个星系就被记录在案，但我们再也无法通过仪器观察到它发出任何形式的光。进一步的调查得出了两种可能的解释。

要么是星系中的恒星同时熄灭，要么是一个巨大到足以遮蔽星系这么大空间区域的实体挡住了光源。这两种解释都违背了正常的逻辑，然而，除非有明显的相反证据，否则无法排除这两种可能性。
texts.en:
Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.

What it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.

The galaxy in question has been documented in our records since the early space era of our species, but we are no longer able to observe it emanating any form of light through our instruments. Further investigation has yielded two possible explanations.

Either the stars of the galaxy in question have simultaneously extinguished, or an entity vast enough to eclipse a galaxy-sized region of space is blocking the light source. Both explanations defy conventional logic, however we cannot rule out these possibilities without significant proof to the contrary.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现灵能者的复数称呼。
note.en: In the game, the plural word for telepaths appears here.

texts.zh: 我们在[queen_system_1.GetName]星系发现的受伤的索林原虫虫后不幸被别人抢走了！他们在治愈了虫后之后，又切断了虫后用来与同族联系的器官。这下虫后可完全听命于他们了。报告还称，虫后已经在孕育幼虫了。
texts.en: Someone else has captured the injured Prethoryn Queen that was discovered in the [queen_system_1.GetName] system! The creature has not only been fully healed, but its connection to the rest of the Scourge has been severed. It now serves its new masters, and reports suggest that it has already started a new brood.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现邻近恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the neighboring star system appears here.

texts.zh:
在最近于[battle_system.GetName]星系中与索林原虫的舰队交火中，我们的部队设法夺取了它们的一只虫后运送的某种卵。卵不久后就孵化了，显露出其中的虫后。

我们的科学家使用神经递质已经安抚了这只虫后。它现在仿佛服从索林原虫蜂巢思维本体一样服从我们下达的命令。我们或许可以利用这只虫后培育一个属于我们自己的小型索林原虫虫群。
texts.en:
In the recent fleet engagement against the Prethoryn in the [battle_system.GetName] system, our forces managed to capture some sort of egg that was being transported by one of their Queens. The egg hatched shortly afterwards, and a Brood-Queen emerged.

Through the use of neural transmitters, our scientists have managed to pacify the creature. It will now obey our commands as if they had been issued by the Prethoryn hive mind itself. We could potentially use this Queen to grow a small Prethoryn brood of our own.

label.zh: 激活遗珍“索林原虫虫后”（10000食物，可重复）
label.en: Activate the Prethoryn Brood-Queen relic (10,000 food; repeatable)

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other star system appears here.

texts.zh: 虫后已经孕育出了一支新的索林原虫舰队，该舰队将环绕[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。当女王处于我们的控制下时，这些生物是绝对忠诚的，并会服从我们的全部命令。
texts.en: The Brood-Queen has spawned a new Prethoryn fleet which has assumed orbit over [Root.Capital.GetName]. With the Queen under our control, the creatures are utterly loyal and will obey our every command.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的首都的名称。
note.en: In the game, your capital's name appears here.

texts.zh:
随着最后一批虫群天灾被消灭，整个宇宙都松了一口气。它们的跨星系入侵已经完全失败，索林原虫曾遮天蔽日的虫群如今也只留下了不计其数的被烈焰灼过的尸体，在虚空中无声飘荡。

轻松与愉快的气息以超光速散播到整个宇宙，无数星球都开始自发举办活动庆祝这一伟大胜利。也许，我们可以借助这一契机，翻开宇宙和平稳定的新篇章？
texts.en:
The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husks that now drift quietly through the void.

A sense of elation and utter joy is spreading across the galaxy at a speed greater than light, and spontaneous victory celebrations have erupted on countless worlds. Could this be the beginning of a new age of galactic peace and stability?

label.zh: 这些不敬的生物，早死早完。
label.en: Those profane creatures will not be missed.

label.zh: 他们的有机科技真是十分有趣啊。
label.en: Their organic technology was most intriguing.

label.zh: 总算为这毫无意义的好斗画上了一个句号。
label.en: Finally an end to all this senseless violence.

label.zh: 那些生物有损我们的生意。
label.en: Those critters were bad for business.

label.zh: 真是我们有史以来遭遇的最恶毒的外星种群啊。
label.en: One of the vilest xeno breeds we've had the misfortune to encounter.

label.zh: 真是悲剧。他们可是十分独特的生命体呢。
label.en: Tragic in a way. They were a unique form of life.

label.zh: 若哨兵组织仍存在：15–25天后宣布解散
label.en: If the Sentinels still exist: they disband 15–25 days later

label.zh: 360天后起：野生索林原虫可能在曾被侵扰的无主星系筑巢（首次出现时通知）
label.en: From 360 days later: feral Prethoryn may nest in unowned, once-infested systems (notice on first appearance)
Victory: the end of the Scourge

note.zh: 虫群国家被消灭后，所有帝国收到此报告；之后可能有哨兵解散与野生索林原虫的余波。脚本中没有虫群获胜的结局事件。
note.en: When the swarm country is destroyed every empire receives this report; the Sentinels' farewell and feral Prethoryn may follow as aftermath. The scripts contain no ending event for a swarm victory.

texts.zh:
历经艰难险阻，我们星系终于获得了胜利，击败了索林原虫。曾经，我还担心这一天永远不会到来。但现在，我就只剩下最后一项任务了。

身为哨兵组织的大团长，我特此宣布解散此组织。我们唯一的目的就是击败索林原虫。既然此目标已经达成，那就该是我们分道扬镳的时候了。为了防止我们现有的战舰遭到滥用，这些战舰将被拆解。

愿此次星河浩劫的结束标志着和平的新纪元的开始。这里是哨兵一号，通信结束。
texts.en:
Against all odds, our galaxy has prevailed. The Prethoryn have been vanquished. I feared this day would never come, but now that victory is here, one last task remains for me.

As the current Grand Master of the Sentinels, I hereby disband our order. Our sole purpose was to see to the defeat of the Scourge, and now that this has been accomplished, it is time for our members to go their separate ways. To prevent their misuse, our surviving battle fleets will be dismantled.

May the defeat of this intergalactic menace herald a new era of peace. This is Sentinel One, signing off.

texts.zh:
在虫群天灾被击败后，我们未能掌握一些趁乱逃跑地索林原虫的踪迹。没有中枢主巢的指引，这些没有心智的野兽大部分会凋谢消散。

然而，最近有目击报告确认，一大群野生索林原虫在[feral_prethoryn_system.GetName]星系建立了一个新巢穴。

在今后，我们有很大可能在虫灾曾经肆虐过的无人占领星系遇见野生虫群巢穴。不过它们不太可能发展成一个大威胁——这些野生生物易于陷入内斗，也没有表现出发展智力并继续演变为虫灾的迹象。
texts.en:
Many Prethoryn creatures remain unaccounted for after the defeat of the Scourge, having slipped away into the depths of space in the ensuing chaos. With no central hive consciousness to guide them, most of these mindless beasts will eventually wither and perish.

However, recent sightings have confirmed that a large number of these feral Prethoryn have established a new lair in the [feral_prethoryn_system.GetName] system.

In the coming years, we will likely face the possibility of more feral Prethoryn nesting in unoccupied systems where the Scourge once had a presence. They are unlikely to develop into a major threat - these wild creatures are prone to infighting and do not exhibit the calculating intelligence that drove the Scourge onwards.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现远方恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the remote star system appears here.

summary.text:
# 索林原虫：银河之外 / The Prethoryn Scourge

- 分类 Category：天灾 Crisis

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 游戏进入终局后，每五年的检查（`crisis_trigger.1`，on_five_year_pulse）从索林原虫、破界者、肃正协议、塞塔娜或“无事发生”中随机选择（基础权重 10/8/10/10/120，受终局年份、天灾类型设置、堕落帝国等修正）。选中索林原虫时，200–800 天后隐藏事件 `crisis.10` 向所有帝国发送“亚空间回声”（crisis.11）。
- 星河卫士的项目 4/5 也可能召来本天灾（`06_projects_nomads.txt:443, 607`）。
- The end-game five-year check picks a crisis at random; for the Prethoryn, hidden crisis.10 sends *Subspace Echoes* 200–800 days later. Defender of the Galaxy projects 4/5 can also summon it.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **三个预兆（按时间先后，由全局标记串联）**：亚空间回声 → 随机延时（隐藏事件12，平均600个月）接近星系外缘 → 随机延时（隐藏事件14，平均120个月）亚空间信号 → 立即收到虫群讯息（crisis.16）。
   Three omens chained by global flags and MTTH; the message follows the signal at once.
2. **先锋入侵**：隐藏事件17（平均30个月）生成虫群国家并发送“第一波接触”（crisis.18）；从此可随时通过外交界面联络虫群（crisis.30，可重复，不是剧情进程）。若已研究“重力陷阱”，30天后收到“凶猛的索林原虫”（大档案馆）。
3. **主力入侵**：先锋抵达400–600天后“第二波接触”（crisis.20）。若存在银河监管人或帝皇，30天后收到其宣告或成员国求援。
4. **战争期间的可能发展**（没有固定先后，都不是必经）：
   - 哨兵组织：虫群占银河15%或超过90个星系后崛起（51→52）；可联络（55）、可能赠舰（71）、在虫群占据过半时分享解剖资料（78）；若其空间站被毁则覆灭（81→82）。
   - 受伤的虫后（101，隐藏事件100，平均820个月，可能整局都不发生）→“俘获虫后”项目 → 自己先完成得到虫后（105），否则收到“虫后被抢走”（107），二者互斥。灵能物种帝国之后可能收到“虚空之洞”（234）。
   - 育母虫后：人类玩家击毁虫后舰时 5/105 机会夺得虫卵（252，全局一次），之后激活遗珍可反复召出新虫群（250）。
5. **结局**：虫群无行星且舰船少于20艘时被年度检查移除，所有帝国收到“虫灾终平”（211）。余波：哨兵15–25天后解散（76）；360天后起野生索林原虫可能筑巢（121，首次出现时通知）。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 唯一的结局事件是胜利（211）；脚本没有虫群获胜的结局事件。/ The only ending event is victory; there is none for a swarm victory.
- 互斥：105 / 107（谁先完成俘获项目）。/ Exclusive: who completes Capture the Queen first.
- 先锋、主力事件的十个选项只是按政府思潮区分的反应，都开启“虚空之鞭”事件链。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 能否读懂虫群讯息：灵能物种或蜂巢思维物种可读出 crisis.16 原文；crisis.30 的“理解”分支还接受巨兽之怒威胁特质“心灵融合”。
- 生物舰船帝国看到 crisis.18 的另一段描述。
- 恐惧黑暗起源在入侵开始与胜利时另有起源事件（外部链接）。

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12 (c5b-crisis)
- 来源 Sources：`events/crisis_events_1.txt`, `events/crisis_trigger_events.txt:9-375`, `events/observer_events.txt:507-616`, `common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt:3235-3263`, `common/relics/relics.txt:785-837`
- 以下为审阅者导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见各篇章。 / Reviewer commentary, not game text.
- 已核对 Checked: crisis_events_1.txt 全部可见事件及隐藏路由（L15-4329）、触发器与 on_action 调用（00_on_actions.txt:90, 233, 709-710, 1411, 1418, 1635, 3607）、项目与遗珍、观察者副本（文本与玩家窗口相同，挂在对应篇章下）。
- 更正 Corrections: 107 原被误挂在 105 之后——它其实发给其他帝国，现为项目的互斥结果；三个预兆、先锋、主力的连接标签补上隐藏事件与平均时间；补齐哨兵、虫后、育母虫后、结局余波的连接，消除全部“次要入口”。
- 不确定 Uncertain: MTTH 为引擎平均值，实际间隔会变化；仅凭“心灵融合”能沟通的帝国在 crisis.16 不匹配任何描述条件，实机表现未验证。
- 覆盖范围 Coverage: 38 篇，全部审阅。
